question.text: Under the SEBI Stewardship Code applicable to Cat III AIFs pursuing an Activist Strategy, which obligation applies?

answer.text: AIFs must actively monitor investee companies, vote on important matters, and have a collaboration policy with other institutional investors.
AIFs must NOT vote in investee company matters to avoid conflicts.
AIFs must disclose voting behaviour only to SEBI, not to investors.
Stewardship Code applies only to Cat I AIFs, not Cat III.

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.4.1 cites the Stewardship Code: all AIFs must actively monitor investees, vote on important matters, and have a clear collaboration policy with other institutional investors to preserve ultimate investor interest. The Trap: Option B inverts the rule. Option C is a distributor-like mis-statement. Option D is wrong — code applies to ALL AIFs. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C (Compliance) tests Stewardship Code broadly. XIX-C covers same.
